verdict.rationale: Marlin's own docs say it automatically generates a fully referenced report (with appendices and references) plus PowerPoint slides, and samples are downloadable. That covers the document/slide side of export, though the report's file format is never named. Nothing shows spreadsheet export or reference-manager formats such as BibTeX or RIS, so only part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: spreadsheet export (CSV/XLSX), reference-manager export (BibTeX/RIS/Zotero), explicit document format (PDF/DOCX), independent hands-on corroboration
